name: Balancer
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The decentralized exchange Balancer disclosed on Twitter that in the Euler Finance attack, about $11.9 million was sent to Euler from the bbeUSD liquidity pool, accounting for 65% of the liquidity pool TVL, and bbeUSD was also deposited The other 4 liquidity pools: wstETH/bbeUSD, rETH/bbeUSD, TEMPLE/bbeUSD, DOLA/bbeUSD, all other Balancer liquidity pools are safe.
